## Description

Please include a summary of the change, relevant context, and which issue is addressed (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] New DNS Provider addition / endpoint update
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Test coverage improvements

## Verification & Quality Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) documents.
- [ ] My changes adhere strictly to the Core Principles (Provider Neutrality, Alphabetical Default, Zero Telemetry).
- [ ] If adding or modifying a provider, I included official HTTPS source reference links.
- [ ] I have run `npm run validate:providers` and it passed.
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved all warnings and errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` and verified the production bundle.
